validation_scope: Both FAST and COMPLETE speech captured from a separate player UID without screen subtitles, actual Chinese output, and no restart after stop.
Japanese model download, actual native model reload without network, and Japanese-to-Chinese translation offline.
Overlay approval precedes projection; cancelling projection cannot start capture.
Backlog batch order/repeats, frozen retries and stale completion cancellation.
Visible recent real-capture translations, pause retention and clearing after sharing stops.
Pause-aware bounded phrase clock, conservative confidence and ordered bounded caption display.
Capture reader remains valid while the worker is blocked during stop and is released after the worker returns.
Prior unit, voice, UI and real Google translation checks.
limitations: Real user phone and Bluetooth headset have not been tested.
No measured speech accuracy percentage or fixed end-to-end latency claim.
Player must permit AudioPlaybackCapture; models need network on first preparation.
A bounded queue rejects new speech during sustained overload with a visible warning.
